stops.note: after Alexei Stakhanov, a Donbas miner who on 31 August 1935 cut 102 tonnes of coal in under six hours, 14 times his quota, in a record staged to launch a productivity campaign
Stakhanov appeared on the cover of Time magazine in December 1935, and the word came to mean any zealously hard worker

current_meaning: an exceptionally hard-working or productive worker
